title: Remove Checked-In Dark Tex Files
description: Stop hand-maintaining six *-dark.tex wrapper files and six duplicate TEMPLATES entries in print/script.ts. Derive each dark PDF automatically at build time from its canonical light .tex file, and let logo/image assets optionally supply a -dark variant by convention.
summary: Light .tex is the only source of truth. Removed all tracked *-dark.tex wrappers; build now derives dark variants into gitignored .semio-dark/ via deriveDarkTexSource + writeDerivedDarkTex, compiling with the light source workDir so inputs/assets resolve. Verified with report light+dark PDF build.
